page.home.title: {site.name} - Minecraft Anarchy Server
page.home.description: {site.name} is a Minecraft anarchy server. Griefing is allowed and the world never resets. Join at {server.ip} or play in your browser.
page.home.intro: bored of the same 26.3, hardened anti cheat, semi rule anarchy servers? <nt>{site.name}</nt> is the Minecraft anarchy server for you. The world is persistent, there are no land claims, and there is no staff intervention. Griefing, stealing, and exploits are allowed. The world will not be reset.

ld.gameserver.description: A persistent Minecraft anarchy server with no land claims and no staff intervention. Griefing, stealing, and exploits are allowed. Native version {version.native}, with Java Edition connections supported from {version.min} through the latest release. Eaglercraft is also supported in a web browser.
page.eaglercraft.title: Play {site.name} in your browser (Eaglercraft)
page.eaglercraft.description: Play {site.name} in your browser with Eaglercraft. Choose a 1.8.8 or 1.12.2 client, normal or WASM, and join. You do not need to install anything.
page.eaglercraft.heading: Play <nt>{site.name}</nt> in your browser
page.eaglercraft.intro_1: Eaglercraft is a port of Minecraft that runs in a web browser. You don't need to install anything. <nt>Nomad</nt> is already in the server list of each client below.
page.eaglercraft.intro_2: Try the WASM builds first. If WASM won't run on your browser or machine, fall back to the standard build.
page.eaglercraft.footer: If you get a blank screen or a crash, try a different build or a different browser.

page.anarchymod.title: UnblockBannedServers Download - {site.name}
page.anarchymod.description: Download UnblockBannedServers, our fork of 6b6t's AnarchyMod that unblocks every server on Mojang's blacklist, not only a fixed list. Fabric and Legacy Fabric, {mod.range}.
page.anarchymod.heading: Download <nt>UnblockBannedServers</nt>
page.anarchymod.intro: We forked AnarchyMod from 6b6t and made it unblock every server on the Mojang server blacklist instead of only unblocking a specific list of servers. You don't currently need this mod to join {site.name}, but it's good to have in case we ever get blacklisted. I recommend installing it or another mod that removes Mojang's server blacklist. It works with Fabric and Legacy Fabric, runs entirely on your side, and the source code is on GitHub. You can also find it on Modrinth and CurseForge.
page.anarchymod.install_1: Install the appropriate mod loader for your Minecraft version:
page.anarchymod.loader_new: Minecraft 1.14 and newer: Fabric Loader
page.anarchymod.loader_old: Minecraft 1.13 and older: Legacy Fabric
page.anarchymod.install_2: Download the UnblockBannedServers JAR matching your Minecraft version.
page.anarchymod.install_3: Place the downloaded JAR into your Minecraft mods folder.
page.anarchymod.install_4: Launch Minecraft using the corresponding Fabric or Legacy Fabric profile.
page.anarchymod.downloads_hint: Click your Minecraft version to download the file.
page.anarchymod.dialog_hint: Choose where to get this version.

page.privacy.title: Privacy Policy - {site.name}
page.privacy.description: What the {site.name} website, the Eaglercraft clients and the game server log, and which other companies can see it.
page.privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
page.privacy.site_text: This site sets no cookies, runs no analytics, has no forms and no accounts. The only thing it stores on your device is your light/dark theme choice, saved in your browser's localStorage under the key "theme". It stays on your device and is never sent anywhere.
page.privacy.hosting_text: The site is served by GitHub Pages, so GitHub handles requests for pages and may log visitor IP addresses and request data under its own policy. The domain's DNS is provided by Cloudflare in DNS-only mode, which means Cloudflare answers lookups for the domain but does not handle page traffic. We don't control or have access to either provider's logs.
page.privacy.eagler_text: The Eaglercraft clients run in your browser and are served from this site. When you play, your browser opens a websocket connection to the game server. The client may also connect to relays, which are used for LAN worlds. These are the default relays built into Eaglercraft X:
page.privacy.relay: %1$s: run by %2$s (%4$s)
page.privacy.eagler_relays: We don't run these relays or control what they log, and their operators' sites are linked above.
page.privacy.eagler_storage: World data and settings from the client are stored locally in your browser.
page.privacy.widget_text: The sidebar on the home, Eaglercraft, vote and UnblockBannedServers pages shows who is online in our Discord server. Your browser requests this from <nt>discord.com</nt> and loads avatars from <nt>cdn.discordapp.com</nt>, so Discord receives your IP address and browser details. We don't control what Discord logs. The list shows the usernames and avatars of members who are online, which Discord publishes through the server widget setting.
page.privacy.server_text_1: Players on Java Edition or Eaglercraft connect directly to the game server at <nt>{server.ip}</nt>, which is separate from the website and is not behind Cloudflare or GitHub.
page.privacy.server_text_2: The server logs anything that PaperMC <nt>1.12.2</nt>, PaperMC <nt>26.2</nt>, and Velocity log, which includes IP addresses, usernames, chat messages, and commands. Logs are kept forever.
page.privacy.other_text: YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and the server list sites linked from the vote page are third parties with their own policies. Old links to /blog on this site redirect to blog.nomadanarchy.online, which is a separate site and is not covered by this page.
